name: Silhouette Rendering
aliases: Point-based illustrative rendering of segmented data
definition: Rendering objects with silhouettes to indicate context objects (like bones) or to discriminate object classes based on specific features (e.g., lymph nodes touching critical structures).
summary: Silhouette rendering extracts significant edges from geometry to create stylized strokes, distinguishing it from image-space methods by operating on pre-extracted primitives for enhanced perceptual clarity.
